question: If JRDRCEBD is coded as 14 16 20 06, then what will be the code for OZCTECHD?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ed82c8a17791b86f1fa7764f746f02a5f72e74a2806de0783a9a01c60a260f78.png] 

 The logic followed here is:

 
• J R D R C E B D → J(10) R(18) D(04) R(18) C(03) E(05) B(02) D(04)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/81c3d4c9692386e8175da7071dab589bcc27c05f18307902c626fe3054343f85.png] 

 
• J(10) + D(04) →10 + 4 = 14 
 
• R(18) - B (02) → 18 - 2 = 16
 
• D(04) × E(05) → 4 × 5 = 20
 
• R(18) ÷ C(03) → 18 ÷ 3 = 06
 
• Here, the code for J R D R C E B D is 14 16 20 06

Similarly, 

 
• O Z C T E C H D → O(15) Z(26) C(03) T(20) E(05) C(03) H(08) D(04)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15f2572e49c521b849b61076b66b8778ae12c83919afd35782d19393e58fe722.png] 

 
• O(15) + D(04) → 15 + 4 = 19
 
• Z(26) - H (08) → 26 - 8 = 18
 
• C(03) × C(03) → 3 × 3 = 09
 
• T(20) ÷ E(05) → 20 ÷ 5 = 04
 
• Here, the code for O Z C T E C H D will be 19 18 09 04.

Hence, the correct answer is '19 18 09 04'.
